subject.title: feat(control-ui): show compaction savings and run time

question: Should Control UI ship compaction-savings and live run-time observability as core chat behavior?
rationale: The change adds persistent user-visible product behavior, and the linked issue plus protected maintainer signals show that implementation quality alone cannot establish product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor both indicators
options.body: Accept the feature direction after correcting the timer clock and adding real Gateway-backed proof.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Select only compaction savings or elapsed run time for this change and defer the other behavior.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Keep the existing compact chat presentation and close the linked feature request and this PR.

recommendation.title: Sponsor both indicators
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction after correcting the timer clock and adding real Gateway-backed proof.
